name: Complete full checkout with a single item
description: End-to-end happy-path validation of the full checkout flow for a single-item cart, from login through order confirmation.
precondition: Fresh browser context, no prior login, empty cart. SauceDemo test environment reachable.

test_steps.description: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com and log in with `standard_user` / `secret_sauce`.
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/inventory.html`; product grid of 6 items visible.

test_steps.description: Click "Add to cart" for "Sauce Labs Backpack".
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "1"; button changes to "Remove".

test_steps.description: Click the cart icon to open the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: `/cart.html` shows "Sauce Labs Backpack", its description, price $29.99, quantity 1.

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html`; heading "Checkout: Your Information"; First Name, Last Name, Zip/Postal Code fields visible.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "John", Last Name "Doe", Zip "12345", click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`; heading "Checkout: Overview".

test_steps.description: Review the overview page contents.
test_steps.expected_result: "Sauce Labs Backpack" qty 1 price $29.99 listed; "Payment Information: SauceCard #31337"; "Shipping Information: Free Pony Express Delivery!"; Item total $29.99, Tax $2.40, Total $32.39.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`; heading "Thank you for your order!" visible; dispatch confirmation text and "Back Home" button visible; cart badge empty.

test_steps.description: Click "Back Home".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/inventory.html`; cart remains empty.

name: Complete checkout with multiple items
description: Validates the checkout flow and price calculations scale correctly for a multi-item cart.
precondition: Fresh browser context, logged out, empty cart.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`; add "Sauce Labs Backpack" and "Sauce Labs Bike Light" to cart from the inventory page.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "2".

test_steps.description: Open the cart page and click "Checkout".
test_steps.expected_result: Both items listed with correct name/description/price/qty=1; user reaches `/checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter valid First Name, Last Name, Zip; click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`; both items listed in the order summary.

test_steps.description: Verify the price breakdown.
test_steps.expected_result: Item total $39.98, Tax $3.20, Total $43.18.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: Order confirmation page shown with success message; cart badge empty.

name: Checkout flow is fully blocked without authentication
description: Confirms unauthenticated users cannot enter the checkout flow via direct URL.
precondition: No active session (logged out / cleared cookies).

test_steps.description: Without logging in, navigate directly to `/checkout-step-one.html`.
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to the login page (`/`); error alert reads: "Epic sadface: You can only access '/checkout-step-one.html' when you are logged in."

name: Cart page displays complete details for every item
description: Verifies the cart page renders name, description, price, and quantity for every item added.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; cart empty at start.

test_steps.description: Log in, add the 3 items to the cart, then open the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Each of the 3 items shows its name, full description text, unit price, and quantity (1) in the cart table.

name: [DISCREPANCY] Cart page does not display a total price
description: Documents that the cart page omits a total/subtotal element, contradicting FR-02.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; two items added to cart.

test_steps.description: Log in, add two items to the cart, open the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (per requirement — FR-02/AC1): The cart page displays the total price calculation for the items in the cart. Observed (live behavior): Only each item's individual unit price is shown; the cart page contains no subtotal, item-total, or grand-total element anywhere — the total only appears later, on the Overview page. Confirmed functional gap against FR-02; flag for stakeholder/product decision rather than treating as a script defect.

name: "Continue Shopping" returns to products page without changing cart
description: Confirms the "Continue Shopping" control navigates back without mutating cart state.
precondition: Logged in; one item in cart.

test_steps.description: Log in, add one item to the cart, open the cart page, click "Continue Shopping".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/inventory.html`; cart badge still shows "1" (cart contents unchanged).

name: Removing an item from the cart page updates the list and badge
description: Confirms item removal on the cart page updates both the item list and the badge count in real time.
precondition: Logged in; two items in cart.

test_steps.description: Log in, add two items to the cart, open the cart page, click "Remove" next to one item.
test_steps.expected_result: Removed item disappears from the cart list; cart badge decrements from "2" to "1".

test_steps.description: Click "Remove" on the remaining item.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart list is empty; cart icon shows "Cart, empty" with no numeric badge.

name: "Checkout" button on cart page redirects to Checkout Information page
description: Confirms the redirect and empty-form state when entering the checkout information step.
precondition: Logged in; one item in cart.

test_steps.description: Log in, add an item to the cart, open the cart page, click "Checkout".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html` with heading "Checkout: Your Information" and an empty First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code form.

name: Submitting with all fields empty shows First Name required error
description: Confirms mandatory-field enforcement and sequential (single-field-at-a-time) error display.
precondition: On the Checkout Information page with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Leave all fields empty and click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: User remains on `/checkout-step-one.html`; error alert reads "Error: First Name is required"; no other field error is shown simultaneously.

name: Submitting with only First Name filled shows Last Name required error
description: Confirms the validation sequence advances to the next empty field.
precondition: On the Checkout Information page with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "John" only, leave Last Name and Zip empty, click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: User remains on `/checkout-step-one.html`; error alert reads "Error: Last Name is required".

name: Submitting with First and Last Name filled shows Postal Code required error
description: Confirms the final field in the validation sequence is enforced.
precondition: On the Checkout Information page with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "John" and Last Name "Doe", leave Zip empty, click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: User remains on `/checkout-step-one.html`; error alert reads "Error: Postal Code is required".

name: Error alert can be dismissed
description: Confirms the dismiss control on the validation error alert works and preserves entered data.
precondition: A required-field error has been triggered on the Checkout Information page.

test_steps.description: Trigger a required-field error (submit with all fields empty), then click the "Dismiss error" (X) icon on the alert.
test_steps.expected_result: The error alert is removed from the page; form fields remain as previously entered.

name: [DISCREPANCY] Special characters in Zip/Postal Code are accepted without validation error
description: Documents that special-character input in the Zip field bypasses validation, contradicting AC5.
precondition: On the Checkout Information page with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "John", Last Name "Doe", Zip "!@#$%^&*()", click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (per requirement — AC5/FR-11): An appropriate validation error message should be shown, and the user should not be able to proceed with special characters in the Zip field. Observed (live behavior): No validation error is shown; the user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` as if the input were valid. Confirmed functional gap against AC5 — treat as expected-fail for automation/healing purposes, not a script bug.

name: [DISCREPANCY] Special characters and emoji in First/Last Name are accepted without validation error
description: Documents that special-character/emoji input in name fields bypasses validation, contradicting AC5.
precondition: On the Checkout Information page with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "@@@###", Last Name "😀🚀🔥", and a valid Zip, click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (per requirement — AC5/FR-11): A validation error should be shown for invalid/special-character name input. Observed (live behavior): No validation error is shown; the user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`, and the Overview page does not redisplay the name fields anywhere for further verification. Confirmed functional gap against AC5.

name: [BOUNDARY] Excessively long field values are accepted with no visible length limit
description: Documents actual behavior for oversized input, since no length limit is specified in the requirement document.
precondition: On the Checkout Information page with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Enter a 300-character string into First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code, click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: No client-side length-limit error is shown; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`. Document actual behavior for stakeholder awareness — no length limit is documented, so this is informational, not a strict pass/fail.

name: Valid data in all fields proceeds to the Overview page
description: Confirms the happy-path submission of the checkout information form.
precondition: On the Checkout Information page with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "Jane", Last Name "Smith", Zip "90210", click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` with heading "Checkout: Overview".

name: Overview page item summary matches cart contents
description: Confirms item data carried from the cart is rendered accurately on the Overview page.
precondition: Logged in; valid checkout info submitted.

test_steps.description: Log in, add "Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket" and "Sauce Labs Onesie" to the cart, complete valid checkout information, reach the Overview page.
test_steps.expected_result: Both items listed with correct name, description, price, and quantity, matching what was shown on the cart page.

name: Overview page shows static payment and shipping information
description: Confirms the mock payment/shipping information block renders as documented in the RA report's assumption ASM-04.
precondition: Overview page reached with any item in cart.

test_steps.description: Reach the Overview page with any item in the cart.
test_steps.expected_result: "Payment Information:" section shows "SauceCard #31337"; "Shipping Information:" section shows "Free Pony Express Delivery!".

name: [BOUNDARY] Tax and total calculations are correct for 1 item vs. multiple items
description: Verifies the 8% tax calculation and total scale correctly between a single-item and multi-item cart.
precondition: Logged in; valid checkout info submitted.

test_steps.description: Complete checkout information with only "Sauce Labs Bike Light" ($9.99) in the cart, reach the Overview page.
test_steps.expected_result: Item total: $9.99, Tax: $0.80, Total: $10.79 (8% tax rate).

test_steps.description: Repeat with 3 items totaling $55.97 (Backpack + Bike Light + Bolt T-Shirt), reach the Overview page.
test_steps.expected_result: Item total: $55.97, Tax: $4.48, Total: $60.45 — verifying the calculation scales correctly with more items.

name: Overview page provides Cancel and Finish options
description: Confirms both required exit controls are present and enabled on the Overview page.
precondition: Overview page reached with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Reach the Overview page with an item in the cart.
test_steps.expected_result: Both a "Cancel" button and a "Finish" button are visible and enabled.

name: Finish redirects to a confirmation page with a success message
description: Confirms the order-completion redirect and confirmation content.
precondition: Overview page reached with valid cart and checkout info.

test_steps.description: Complete the full checkout flow through the Overview page, then click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`; a "Pony Express" image, heading "Thank you for your order!", and dispatch confirmation text are displayed.

name: "Back Home" returns to the Products page
description: Confirms the confirmation page's exit control returns the user to the catalog.
precondition: On the order confirmation page.

test_steps.description: From the order confirmation page, click "Back Home".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/inventory.html`; the products grid is displayed.

name: Cart is empty immediately after order completion
description: Confirms the cart-clearing post-condition of a completed order, verified both on the confirmation page and by direct navigation.
precondition: Checkout completed with 2 items.

test_steps.description: Complete a checkout with 2 items in the cart through to the confirmation page.
test_steps.expected_result: The cart icon shows "Cart, empty" with no numeric badge on the confirmation page itself, before clicking "Back Home".

test_steps.description: Navigate to `/cart.html` directly.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart page shows no items, confirming BR4/FR-14.

name: [UNDOCUMENTED FEATURE] "Generate PDF order" button is present and does not error
description: Records the existence and basic functioning of a UI feature not described anywhere in the requirement document.
precondition: On the order confirmation page.

test_steps.description: On the order confirmation page, locate and click "Generate PDF order".
test_steps.expected_result: The action completes without a JavaScript error or broken navigation. Note: this button is not described anywhere in the requirement document; flagged for stakeholder awareness rather than treated as in/out of scope automatically.

name: Direct access to Checkout Information page while logged out is blocked
description: Confirms server-side/route-level auth enforcement on the checkout information page.
precondition: No active session (fresh/cleared session).

test_steps.description: Without logging in, navigate directly to `/checkout-step-one.html`.
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to the login page; error alert: "Epic sadface: You can only access '/checkout-step-one.html' when you are logged in."

name: Direct access to Cart page while logged out is blocked
description: Confirms server-side/route-level auth enforcement on the cart page.
precondition: No active session.

test_steps.description: Without logging in, navigate directly to `/cart.html`.
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to the login page; error alert: "Epic sadface: You can only access '/cart.html' when you are logged in."

name: [DISCREPANCY] Checkout with an empty cart is not blocked by the application
description: Documents that the application allows a complete, zero-item order to be placed, contradicting BR3/FR-13.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user` with an empty cart.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user` with an empty cart, open the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (per requirement — BR3/FR-13): "Checkout" should be disabled/blocked when the cart is empty. Observed (live behavior): "Checkout" button is present and enabled despite the cart being empty.

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout", fill in valid First Name/Last Name/Zip, click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (per requirement): The user should not be able to reach the Overview page with an empty cart, or should see a blocking message. Observed (live behavior): User reaches the Overview page showing "Item total: $0", "Tax: $0.00", "Total: $0.00" with no items listed; no blocking message is shown.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (per requirement): Completing an order with zero items should not be possible. Observed (live behavior): Order confirmation page is shown as if a normal order succeeded. Confirmed functional gap against BR3/FR-13 — document for stakeholder review; downstream automation/healing should classify this as an application issue if it fails, not attempt to "fix" the script to hide the gap.

name: Cancel on Checkout Information page returns to the Cart page
description: Confirms the Cancel control on step one behaves per BR5.
precondition: On the Checkout Information page with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Reach the Checkout Information page with an item in the cart, then click "Cancel".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/cart.html`; the item added earlier is still present in the cart.

name: [DISCREPANCY] Cancel on the Overview page returns to Products, not Cart
description: Documents that Cancel on step two navigates to the Products page rather than the Cart page, contradicting the literal wording of BR5.
precondition: On the Checkout Overview page (step two) with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: Reach the Checkout Overview page (step two) with an item in the cart, then click "Cancel".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (per requirement — BR5): User should return to the Cart page ("cancel at any step and return to cart"). Observed (live behavior): User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page), NOT `/cart.html` — contradicts the literal wording of BR5. The item remains in the cart (verified by navigating to `/cart.html` afterward). Document as a finding for stakeholder clarification rather than a definitive pass/fail.

name: Browser back button from Overview clears entered form data
description: Documents observed (not assumed) behavior of the browser back button mid-checkout, resolving an RA report edge case.
precondition: Valid checkout information submitted; Overview page reached.

test_steps.description: Reach the Overview page after entering valid checkout information (item in cart).
test_steps.expected_result: Overview page is displayed correctly.

test_steps.description: Click the browser's Back button.
test_steps.expected_result: User lands back on `/checkout-step-one.html`; First Name, Last Name, and Zip fields are all empty (previously entered data is not restored); cart badge still shows the correct item count.

name: Page refresh mid-checkout clears form data but preserves cart
description: Documents observed behavior of a page refresh mid-checkout-information-entry.
precondition: On the Checkout Information page with an item in cart.

test_steps.description: On the Checkout Information page, enter First Name and Last Name (leave Zip blank), then refresh the page.
test_steps.expected_result: Page reloads at `/checkout-step-one.html`; First Name and Last Name fields are now empty; cart badge count is unchanged from before the refresh.

name: Direct URL navigation to Checkout Information page works when logged in with items in cart
description: Confirms the checkout information route does not require having visited the cart page first.
precondition: Logged in; item added to cart via inventory page.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`, add an item to the cart via the inventory page, then navigate directly to `/checkout-step-one.html` (bypassing the cart page's Checkout button).
test_steps.expected_result: The Checkout Information form loads successfully without requiring the user to visit `/cart.html` first.

name: Logout blocks subsequent access to checkout pages
description: Confirms logout fully terminates the session with respect to checkout-route access.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`, open the hamburger menu, and click "Logout".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page (`/`).

test_steps.description: Attempt to navigate directly to `https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-one.html`.
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected back to the login page with the "You can only access ... when you are logged in" error, confirming the session was fully terminated.

name: Cart badge accurately reflects add/remove actions across pages
description: Confirms the cart badge stays consistent across the inventory and cart pages as items are added/removed.
precondition: Logged in; empty cart.

test_steps.description: From the inventory page, add 3 different items one at a time, checking the cart badge after each.
test_steps.expected_result: Badge increments 1 → 2 → 3 correctly after each add.

test_steps.description: Open the cart page and remove 1 item.
test_steps.expected_result: Badge updates to "2" immediately, consistent between the header icon and the cart page.

name: [BOUNDARY] Single item vs. multiple items checkout totals scale correctly
description: Confirms the 8% tax calculation scales correctly from 1 item up to the full 6-item catalog.
precondition: Logged in; valid checkout info submitted.

test_steps.description: Complete checkout information with exactly 1 item in the cart and reach the Overview page.
test_steps.expected_result: Item total equals that single item's price; Tax = 8% of item total (rounded to 2 decimals); Total = item total + tax.

test_steps.description: Repeat with all 6 available items added to the cart and reach the Overview page.
test_steps.expected_result: Item total equals the sum of all 6 item prices; Tax and Total are calculated consistently using the same 8% rate.

name: [EDGE CASE] Rapid double-click on "Finish" does not produce a broken or duplicate state
description: Documents current application behavior on rapid double-submission of the Finish action, since no idempotency rule exists in the requirement document.
precondition: Overview page reached with valid cart and checkout info.

test_steps.description: Reach the Overview page with a valid cart and checkout information, then double-click the "Finish" button as fast as possible.
test_steps.expected_result: User lands on a single, well-formed `/checkout-complete.html` page with no duplicate confirmation banners, console errors, or broken layout. Record the actual observed behavior — the requirement document defines no explicit idempotency rule for this action, so this documents current behavior for stakeholder awareness rather than asserting a specific pass/fail expectation.
